About Us

At Barniecom Hair, we are passionate about helping you look and feel beautiful. From wig reconstruction and installation to styling, colouring and revamping, we focus on neat work and a lovely finish.

Education

Our doors are also opened to people who are willing to learn hair styling at an affordable price.

Booking Policy

Booking & Studio Policy

  1. Rescheduling & Changes: If you need to change your booking date or time, you must notify us at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled appointment.
  2. Punctuality: Lateness will not be tolerated, as it directly impacts the appointment time reserved for the next client.
  3. Booking Confirmation: Always ensure your booking is fully confirmed prior to your set appointment.
  4. Hair & Lace Approval: Your hair bundles, laces, or wig type must always be reviewed and confirmed by the stylist before your appointment date.
